title: Add guarded manual-selection change tracking in AddItemSheet
description: Introduce the programmatic-update suppression state and `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` logic so manual user changes mark the aisle as manually selected and clear the auto-detect cue only when the change was not programmatic.
acceptance_criteria: AddItemSheet defines a dedicated state flag for suppressing manual-selection side effects during programmatic updates.
A small helper or equivalent synchronous mechanism wraps programmatic aisle mutations by toggling the suppression flag around the write.
An `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` handler marks `isAisleManuallySelected = true` and `isAutoDetected = false` only when suppression is not active.
The change-tracking logic is contained within AddItemSheet and does not alter unrelated auto-detect behavior.
